theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_lpo_current_toolkit
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ X.support, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |X ψ| ≤ c * X.mass.toReal) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (C : ℝ), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |T ω| ≤ C * c) → T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (η η' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (W : Set (Euclid N)), IsOpen W → X.support ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ W, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = (η' : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) → X η = X η') ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → IsCompact Y.support → Y.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn Y univ < ∞ → (X - Y).support ⊆ X.support ∪ Y.support ∧ IsCompact (X - Y).support ∧ (X - Y).mass < ∞ ∧ boundaryMassOn (X - Y) univ < ∞) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)), IsCompact X.support → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.support ⊆ X.support ∧ IsCompact X.boundary.support ∧ boundaryMassOn X.boundary univ < ∞
